dashboard.desc: Manage your shop, list new offers, and track your business performance all in one place.
dashboard.emptyCatalogDesc: Start publishing offers to showcase them to your customers.

onboarding.launchDesc: To start publishing deals, sharing posters, and attracting local shoppers, you first need to set up your virtual shop profile.

onboarding.listOffersDesc: Create promotional posters using our AI studio or design canvas.
